# 1ms.dog

> Free browser tool: shows the visitor's exit IP (IPv4, IPv6, ISP/ASN, city, nearest Cloudflare edge, proxy/VPN/WebRTC
> hints) and times real HTTPS round trips from their browser to 40 major services plus a local pack
> chosen by exit country. Everything runs client-side; no results are sent to 1ms.dog.

- Home: https://1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- Service pages: every one of the 84 services has its own page in every language: https://1ms.dog/chatgpt/, https://1ms.dog/claude/, https://1ms.dog/gemini/, https://1ms.dog/copilot/, - Speed grades (median HTTPS round trip): 1ms dog < 2 ms, Zoomies ≤ 30, Sprint ≤ 80, Trot ≤ 150, Stroll ≤ 300, Nap > 300, Not back = no connection in 5 s
